verdict.rationale: Sprinto has its own documented API surface, but it is narrow: custom-integration push APIs with integration monitoring (sprinto-docs-16), Framework Health and Vendor Data APIs (sprinto-docs-17), and inbound ingestion webhooks (sprinto-docs-48). Most capabilities are documented only as UI 'dashboard actions', including access reviews, vendor risk assessments, AI-systems management, findings/tasks and audit-partner selection. No OpenAPI spec was found at any probed path (sprinto-probe-3). Missing for 10: any evidence of API coverage for the UI workflows (access reviews, tasks, policies, risks, AI systems, audits), a published OpenAPI/full API reference, and independent confirmation of API–UI parity.
